purpose: the user asked to see whether it walks and to see a video. This renders exactly what the current best configuration does, with no physics change and no rendering-side motion
model: triad pad body (three spheres per tarsus, radius 0.008, pads coplanar with the material point) with actuator ctrlrange doubled, the pose re-solved for triad contact at COM 1.45, policy MODEL_slipmetric.npz
tick: 1 ms policy tick, base target at 200 Hz, C = 0.02, releasable adhesion 0.25 body weight, friction 1.5

two_videos.cold_start_3.2s.mp4: no assist at all: from the solved pose, 3.2 s
two_videos.assist_then_release.mp4: 1 s measured-target assist then 3 s autonomous, which is the protocol used for the release numbers

honesty: the assist phase is labelled on screen and is not autonomous. Slow motion (5x) is stated on screen. Nothing is scripted, translated or posed; the camera follows the fly but the checkered floor is world-fixed so slip is visible
labelling: derived body, derived actuator, derived adhesion, replacement ANN. This is NOT accepted walking and NOT frozen-body acceptance
